changes: FRACT adds three overlapping grains from a Flex sample to FX2, with position, size, direction, scatter, shape and stereo SPACE controls.
Use a Flex track with TSTR OFF. One FRACT track can play at a time; other FRACT tracks play dry and display the owner track.
Above SPCE 96, a darker tail and linked stereo envelope smoothing soften repeated attacks. SPCE 0–96 and grain rendering are unchanged; individual grains can remain audible at 127.
Install over USB with FX2 id 7. Earlier development Parts need FRACT reselected and defaults reset; see the migration notes in README.md.

Experimental: the exact package was accepted on an Octatrack MKII, with partial listening results. Full controls, CPU and persistence checks remain unverified; SETUP controls take no locks, LFOs or scenes.
